svg.title: Just to Study platform architecture
svg.desc: A Next.js student app, an Angular teacher and admin workspace and a Flutter mobile app talk to a Spring Boot API over REST and WebSocket. The API covers live lessons, homework, the adaptive placement test, the course catalog and notifications, and stores data in PostgreSQL, files in MinIO and sends push through Firebase Cloud Messaging.
